title: Failed to build template for Godot 3.3.3-stable
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 3.3.3.stable
- Not reproducible in: Not tested

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS 24.04 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - llvmpipe (LLVM 20.1.2, 256 bits) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-12100F (8 threads) - 15.52 GiB memory

### Steps to reproduce

1. clone the project with command: git clone -b 3.3.3-stable --single-branch https://github.com/godotengine/godot.git
2. cd into godot folder
3. install mingw64 and other requirements shows in the 3.x documantation
4. run scons -platform=windows -tools=no -target=release -j 8
5. error occurs after some compile of codes

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Doesn't need a project.
